entries.usage: die Erinnerung, die Erinnerungen. 'In Erinnerung rufen' (to call to mind). 'Zahlungserinnerung' (payment reminder).

examples.sentence: Die Kindheit ist eine schöne Erinnerung.
examples.translation: Childhood is a beautiful memory.

examples.sentence: Er schickte eine schriftliche Erinnerung. (Reminder)
examples.translation: He sent a written reminder.

examples.sentence: Wenn meine Erinnerung deutlicher wäre, fände ich den Weg.
examples.translation: If my recollection were clearer, I would find the way.

examples.sentence: Die Erinnerung wird durch Fotos wachgehalten.
examples.translation: The memory is kept alive by photos.

entries.intro: The cognitive memory capacity, mind, or remembrance. Suffix -nis makes it neuter. Related to verb 'denken'. Related to 'Andenken' (#1940) and 'Erinnerung' (#1941).
entries.usage: das Gedächtnis, des Gedächtnisses. Plural is rare. 'Aus dem Gedächtnis' (from memory). 'Gedächtnislücke' (lapse of memory).

examples.sentence: Er hat ein hervorragendes Gedächtnis für Zahlen.
examples.translation: He has an excellent memory for numbers.

examples.sentence: Das Ereignis blieb mir fest im Gedächtnis.
examples.translation: The event remained firmly in my memory (mind).

examples.sentence: Wenn mein Gedächtnis besser wäre, verhieße ich keine Termine.
examples.translation: If my memory were better, I wouldn't miss appointments.

examples.sentence: Das Gedächtnis wird durch tägliches Training gestärkt.
examples.translation: The memory is strengthened by daily training.

entries.intro: Present participle of the verb 'agieren' (to act / operate - Chunk 20 companion) used as adjective meaning acting or operating. Related to 'amtierend' (#1944) and 'geschäftsführend' (#1945).
entries.usage: Regular adjective or participle adverbial.

examples.sentence: Die im Hintergrund agierenden Personen blieben anonym. (Persons pl)
examples.translation: The people acting in the background remained anonymous.

examples.sentence: Er verbrachte das Jahr, als Vermittler agierend.
examples.translation: He spent the year operating (acting) as a mediator.

examples.sentence: Wenn der agierende Chef mutiger wäre, sparten wir Geld. (Subjunctive adj)
examples.translation: If the acting boss were braver, we would save money.

examples.sentence: Das agierende Team wird von der Zentrale koordiniert.
examples.translation: The operating team is coordinated by headquarters.

entries.intro: Present participle of the verb 'amtieren' (to hold office / officiate - Chunk 20 companion) used as adjective meaning incumbent or officiating. Related to 'agierend' (#1943) and 'geschäftsführend' (#1945).
entries.usage: Regular adjective (der amtierende Bürgermeister - the incumbent mayor).

examples.sentence: Der amtierende Meister verlor das Spiel. (Incumbent champion m)
examples.translation: The incumbent champion lost the game.

examples.sentence: Wir besprachen das Problem mit dem amtierenden Vorstand. (Board m)
examples.translation: We discussed the problem with the incumbent board.

examples.sentence: Wenn der amtierende Chef strenger wäre, gäbe es keine Fehler.
examples.translation: If the incumbent boss were stricter, there would be no errors.

examples.sentence: Die Urkunde wird vom amtierenden Notar unterschrieben. (Notary m)
examples.translation: The document is signed by the officiating notary.

entries.intro: Describes a managing role, executive board, or acting director. Compound of 'Geschäft' (business - Chunk 7) and present participle 'führend' (leading/conducting - Chunk 13). Related to 'agierend' (#1943) and 'amtierend' (#1944).
entries.usage: Regular adjective (der geschäftsführende Vorstand - the executive board).

examples.sentence: Er arbeitet als geschäftsführender Gesellschafter. (Managing partner m)
examples.translation: He works as a managing partner.

examples.sentence: Die geschäftsführende Direktorin stellte das Budget vor.
examples.translation: The managing director presented the budget.

examples.sentence: Wenn die geschäftsführende Person vorsichtiger wäre, sparten wir Steuern.
examples.translation: If the managing person were more cautious, we would save taxes.

examples.sentence: Das Komitee wird als geschäftsführend bezeichnet.
examples.translation: The committee is designated as executive (managing).

entries.intro: A personal interest, concern, or curiosity. Loanword. Related to verb 'interessieren'. Related to 'Nase' (#1947) and 'disponiert' (#1948).
entries.usage: das Interesse, des Interesses, die Interessen. 'Interesse wecken' (to arouse interest). 'Im Interesse von' (in the interest of).

examples.sentence: Er zeigt großes Interesse an der Wissenschaft. (Science f)
examples.translation: He shows great interest in science.

examples.sentence: Das Buch erweckte mein Interesse.
examples.translation: The book aroused my interest.

examples.sentence: Wenn das Projekt mehr Interesse fände, bekämen wir Geld.
examples.translation: If the project found more interest, we would get money.

examples.sentence: Die Entscheidung wird im Interesse des Kunden gefällt.
examples.translation: The decision is made in the interest of the customer.

entries.intro: The anatomical nose, snout of an animal, or technical projection/tab. Related to 'Interesse' (#1946) and 'disponiert' (#1948).
entries.usage: die Nase, die Nasen. 'Nasenspitze' (tip of nose). 'Die Nase vorn haben' (idiom: to be ahead / lead). 'Die Nase voll haben' (idiom: to be fed up).

examples.sentence: Er hat eine rote Nase von der Kälte. (Cold f)
examples.translation: He has a red nose from the cold.

examples.sentence: Der Hund steckt seine Nase in jedes Loch. (Hole n)
examples.translation: The dog sticks its nose in every hole.

examples.sentence: Wenn meine Nase nicht verstopft wäre, böte ich dir Blumen an. (Subjunctive verb 'bieten', clogged nose)
examples.translation: If my nose weren't clogged, I would offer you flowers.

examples.sentence: Die Nase des Bauteils wird in die Nut gesteckt. (Technical projection/tab f, groove f)
examples.translation: The tab of the component is inserted into the groove.

entries.intro: Present 3rd singular or past participle of the verb 'disponieren' (to schedule / dispose - Chunk 20 companion), or adjective meaning disposed, inclined, or scheduled. Related to 'plant' (#1949) and 'folgend' (#1951).
entries.usage: Regular adjective (gut disponiert sein - to be in a good mood/shape). Verb: er disponiert.

examples.sentence: Der Logistiker disponiert die Lkw für morgen. (Logistics officer m, trucks pl)
examples.translation: The logistics planner schedules the trucks for tomorrow.

examples.sentence: Er war heute sehr gut disponiert. (In good shape/disposed)
examples.translation: He was in very good shape (disposed) today.

examples.sentence: Wenn das Material besser disponiert wäre, gäbe es keine Verzögerung. (Delay f)
examples.translation: If the material were scheduled better, there would be no delay.

examples.sentence: Die Lieferung wird vom Disponenten disponiert. (Dispatcher m)
examples.translation: The delivery is scheduled by the dispatcher.

entries.intro: Present 3rd person singular of the verb 'planen' (to plan / project - Chunk 1). Related to 'disponiert' (#1948) and 'anschließend' (#1950).
entries.usage: Weak regular verb: planen, plante, hat geplant. present: er plant. Transitive.

examples.sentence: Der Architekt plant ein neues Einkaufszentrum. (Mall n)
examples.translation: The architect is planning a new shopping mall.

examples.sentence: Sie plant eine Reise nach Italien.
examples.translation: She is planning a trip to Italy.

examples.sentence: Wenn er das Projekt vorsichtiger plante, sparte er Geld.
examples.translation: If he planned the project more cautiously, he would save money.

examples.sentence: Die Hochzeit wird von einem Hochzeitsplaner geplant. (Wedding f)
examples.translation: The wedding is planned by a wedding planner.

entries.translation: subsequent / following / adjoining / afterwards / subsequently / connecting
entries.intro: Present participle of the strong separable verb 'anschließen' (to connect/join - Chunk 15 companion) used as adjective meaning subsequent/adjoining, or adverb meaning afterwards/subsequently. Related to 'folgend' (#1951) and 'folgende' (#1952).
entries.usage: Regular adjective (das anschließende Gebäude). Adverbial: afterwards / subsequently.

examples.sentence: Wir trinken einen Kaffee und gehen anschließend ins Kino. (Afterwards)
examples.translation: We drink a coffee and go to the cinema afterwards.

examples.sentence: Das Zimmer liegt im anschließenden Korridor. (Adjoining corridor m)
examples.translation: The room is located in the adjoining corridor.

examples.sentence: Wenn die anschließende Prüfung einfacher wäre, bestünde er sie. (Subsequent exam f)
examples.translation: If the subsequent exam were easier, he would pass it.

examples.sentence: Das Treffen wird nach der anschließenden Pause fortgesetzt. (Active context)
examples.translation: The meeting is continued after the subsequent break.

entries.intro: Present participle of the verb 'folgen' (to follow - Chunk 2) used as adjective meaning following or subsequent. Related to 'folgende' (#1952) and 'Badezimmer' (#1953).
entries.usage: Regular adjective (das folgende Kapitel).

examples.sentence: Wir lesen das folgende Kapitel im Buch.
examples.translation: We are reading the following chapter in the book.

examples.sentence: Er verbrachte den Tag, den Anweisungen folgend. (Adverbial: following instructions)
examples.translation: He spent the day following the instructions.

examples.sentence: Wenn das folgende Jahr besser verliefe, wäre ich froh. (Subjunctive verb 'verlaufen')
examples.translation: If the following year went better, I would be glad.

examples.sentence: Die folgende Frage wird vom Lehrer gestellt.
examples.translation: The following question is asked by the teacher.

entries.intro: Inflected feminine/plural/weak form of the adjective 'folgend' (#1951), or declines as noun meaning the following thing/points ('das Folgende'). Related to 'Badezimmer' (#1953) and 'aufgebaut' (#1954).
entries.usage: Inflected adjective (eine folgende Reaktion). Noun: das Folgende, des Folgenden.

examples.sentence: Bitte beachten Sie das Folgende. (Noun: the following)
examples.translation: Please note the following.

examples.sentence: Die folgende Zeile ist unleserlich. (Adjective, line f)
examples.translation: The following line is illegible.

examples.sentence: Wenn das die folgende Aufgabe wäre, löste ich sie leicht.
examples.translation: If that were the following task, I would solve it easily.

examples.sentence: Die folgende Sendung wird auf Deutsch ausgestrahlt.
examples.translation: The following broadcast is aired in German.

entries.intro: A bathroom. Compound of 'Bad' (bath - Chunk 8 companion) and 'Zimmer' (room - Chunk 3). Related to 'aufgebaut' (#1954) and 'gebaut' (#1955).
entries.usage: das Badezimmer, des Badezimmers, die Badezimmer (plural identical). 'Gästebadezimmer' (guest bathroom).

examples.sentence: Er duscht sich im Badezimmer.
examples.translation: He takes a shower in the bathroom.

examples.sentence: Das Badezimmer hat blaue Fliesen. (Tiles pl)
examples.translation: The bathroom has blue tiles.

examples.sentence: Wenn das Badezimmer größer wäre, stellte ich eine Badewanne auf. (Bathtub f)
examples.translation: If the bathroom were larger, I would set up a bathtub.

examples.sentence: Das Badezimmer wird vom Reinigungsdienst geputzt.
examples.translation: The bathroom is cleaned by the cleaning service.

entries.translation: set up / built / constructed / structured / aufgebaut
entries.intro: Past participle of the separable verb 'aufbauen' (to build up / set up - Chunk 9) used as adjective meaning set up, constructed, or structured. Related to 'gebaut' (#1955) and 'enger' (#1956).
entries.usage: Regular adjective (eine logisch aufgebaute Rede).

examples.sentence: Das Zelt ist im Garten aufgebaut.
examples.translation: The tent is set up in the garden.

examples.sentence: Seine Argumentation war klug aufgebaut.
examples.translation: His argumentation was cleverly structured.

examples.sentence: Wenn der Schrank stabiler aufgebaut wäre, rutschte er nicht.
examples.translation: If the wardrobe were set up more sturdily, it wouldn't slide.

examples.sentence: Die Bühne wird für das Konzert aufgebaut.
examples.translation: The stage is set up for the concert.

entries.intro: Past participle of the verb 'bauen' (to build - Chunk 2) used as adjective meaning built or constructed. Related to 'enger' (#1956) and 'Schimmer' (#1957).
entries.usage: Regular adjective (ein neu gebautes Haus).

examples.sentence: Das Haus wurde vor zehn Jahren gebaut.
examples.translation: The house was built ten years ago.

examples.sentence: Er hat eine Spielzeugburg gebaut. (Toy castle f)
examples.translation: He built a toy castle.

examples.sentence: Wenn die Brücke sicherer gebaut wäre, überquerte ich sie. (Subjunctive verb 'überqueren')
examples.translation: If the bridge were built safer, I would cross it.

examples.sentence: Das Auto wird in einer modernen Fabrik gebaut.
examples.translation: The car is built in a modern factory.

entries.intro: Comparative form of the adjective 'eng' (narrow / tight / close). Related to 'Schimmer' (#1957) and 'Strahl' (#1958).
entries.usage: Comparative adjective (eine engere Straße). Adverbial: tighter / closer. 'Enger Kontakt' (close contact).

examples.sentence: Wir müssen in engerem Kontakt bleiben.
examples.translation: We must remain in closer contact.

examples.sentence: Die Hose muss enger gemacht werden.
examples.translation: The trousers must be made tighter.

examples.sentence: Wenn der Flur enger wäre, passte das Regal nicht hinein. (Corridor m, shelf n)
examples.translation: If the corridor were narrower, the shelf wouldn't fit inside.

examples.sentence: Die Grenze wird enger gezogen. (Border f)
examples.translation: The border is drawn tighter.

entries.intro: A weak light glimmer, gleam, shimmer, or colloquially a clue ('keinen Schimmer haben' - to have no clue). Related to verb 'schimmern'. Related to 'enger' (#1956) and 'Strahl' (#1958).
entries.usage: der Schimmer, des Schimmers. Plural is rare. 'Keinen Schimmer haben' (to have no clue). 'Hoffnungsschimmer' (glimmer of hope).

examples.sentence: Ein schwacher Schimmer von Hoffnung blieb uns.
examples.translation: A weak glimmer of hope remained to us.

examples.sentence: Ich habe keinen Schimmer, wo er ist. (No clue)
examples.translation: I have no clue where he is.

examples.sentence: Wenn ein Schimmer von Licht da wäre, sähe ich den Pfad. (Creek/path m)
examples.translation: If a glimmer of light were there, I would see the path.

examples.sentence: Der ferne Schimmer wird von den Kameras aufgenommen. (Gleam m)
examples.translation: The distant shimmer is captured by the cameras.

entries.intro: A beam/ray of light, jet of fluid/water, or squirt. Related to verb 'strahlen'. Related to 'Schimmer' (#1957) and 'Bande' (#1959).
entries.usage: der Strahl, des Strahl(e)s, die Strahlen. 'Lichtstrahl' (beam of light). 'Wasserstrahl' (jet of water).

examples.sentence: Ein warmer Sonnenstrahl traf mein Gesicht. (Face n)
examples.translation: A warm sunbeam hit my face.

examples.sentence: Der Wasserstrahl spritzt aus dem Schlauch. (Hose m)
examples.translation: The water jet squirts from the hose.

examples.sentence: Wenn der Laserstrahl stärker wäre, schnitte er Metall. (Laser beam m)
examples.translation: If the laser beam were stronger, it would cut metal.

examples.sentence: Die Strahlen werden durch das Prisma abgelenkt. (Rays pl, prism n)
examples.translation: The rays are deflected by the prism.

entries.translation: gang / band (criminals - feminine 'die Bande') / boards / rink border (sports) / bonds (plural of 'Band' - neuter 'die Bande')
entries.intro: A gang of criminals (feminine), rink boards/barrier, or personal bonds/links (plural of neuter 'das Band'). Related to 'Frequenzbereich' (#1960) and 'stöhnt' (#1961).
entries.usage: die Bande (gang), die Banden. die Bande (bonds pl of das Band). 'Verbrecherbande' (gang of criminals). 'Bandenwerbung' (perimeter advertising).

examples.sentence: Die kriminelle Bande wurde verhaftet.
examples.translation: The criminal gang was arrested.

examples.sentence: Die Bande der Freundschaft verbinden uns. (Bonds pl)
examples.translation: The bonds of friendship connect us.

examples.sentence: Wenn die Bande stärker wären, trennten wir uns nicht. (Bonds pl)
examples.translation: If the bonds were stronger, we wouldn't separate.

examples.sentence: Der Puck prallt von der Bande ab. (Rink boards f)
examples.translation: The puck bounces off the boards.

entries.intro: A technical frequency range or band. Compound of 'Frequenz' (frequency) and 'Bereich' (range/area - Chunk 3). Related to 'Bande' (#1959) and 'stöhnt' (#1961).
entries.usage: der Frequenzbereich, des Frequenzbereich(e)s, die Frequenzbereiche.

examples.sentence: Das Radio empfängt Signale im UKW-Frequenzbereich.
examples.translation: The radio receives signals in the FM frequency range.

examples.sentence: Dieser Frequenzbereich ist für den Mobilfunk reserviert.
examples.translation: This frequency range is reserved for mobile communications.

examples.sentence: Wenn der Frequenzbereich breiter wäre, übertrugen wir mehr Daten.
examples.translation: If the frequency range were broader, we would transmit more data.

examples.sentence: Der Frequenzbereich wird von der Bundesnetzagentur reguliert.
examples.translation: The frequency range is regulated by the federal network agency.

entries.intro: Present 3rd person singular of the verb 'stöhnen' (to groan / moan / sigh - Chunk 20 companion). Related to 'scheinbar' (#1962) and 'aufgeregt' (#1963).
entries.usage: Weak regular verb: stöhnen, stöhnte, hat gestöhnt. present: er stöhnt. Intransitive or transitive.

examples.sentence: Der verletzte Mann stöhnt vor Schmerz. (Pain m)
examples.translation: The injured man groans with pain.

examples.sentence: Er stöhnt über die schwere Arbeit.
examples.translation: He groans (complains) about the heavy work.

examples.sentence: Wenn er weniger stöhnte, wäre das Arbeiten angenehmer. (Subjunctive verb 'stöhnen')
examples.translation: If he groaned less, working would be more pleasant.

examples.sentence: Der Laut wird vom Patienten gestöhnt. (Uncommon passive context)
examples.translation: The sound is groaned by the patient.

entries.intro: Describes something seemingly or apparently true (but perhaps not in reality). Suffix -bar makes it adjective from verb 'scheinen' (to seem). Related to 'stöhnt' (#1961) and 'aufgeregt' (#1963).
entries.usage: Regular adjective (ein scheinbarer Widerspruch - an apparent contradiction). Adverbial: apparently.

examples.sentence: Das war ein scheinbarer Erfolg. (Apparent success m)
examples.translation: That was an apparent success.

examples.sentence: Er hat das Problem scheinbar gelöst. (Apparently)
examples.translation: He has apparently solved the problem.

examples.sentence: Wenn der Grund scheinbarer wäre, glaubte ich ihm nicht.
examples.translation: If the reason were more seeming (less concrete), I wouldn't believe him.

examples.sentence: Die Lage wird als scheinbar ruhig beschrieben.
examples.translation: The situation is described as seemingly calm.

entries.intro: Past participle of the separable verb 'aufregen' (to excite / upset - Chunk 15 companion) used as adjective meaning excited, nervous, or agitated. Related to 'gereizt' (#1964) and 'verlierend' (#1965).
entries.usage: Regular adjective (eine aufgeregte Stimme).

examples.sentence: Die Kinder sind sehr aufgeregt vor Weihnachten.
examples.translation: The children are very excited before Christmas.

examples.sentence: Er sprach mit aufgeregter Stimme.
examples.translation: He spoke with an excited (agitated) voice.

examples.sentence: Wenn ich weniger aufgeregt wäre, schriebe ich sauberer.
examples.translation: If I were less excited (nervous), I would write neater.

examples.sentence: Die Menge wird durch die Nachricht aufgeregt gemacht. (Agitated/passive)
examples.translation: The crowd is made excited by the news.

entries.intro: Past participle of the verb 'reizen' (to irritate / provoke - Chunk 20 companion) used as adjective meaning irritable, touchy, or irritated. Related to 'aufgeregt' (#1963) and 'verlierend' (#1965).
entries.usage: Regular adjective (eine gereizte Stimmung - an irritable mood).

examples.sentence: Er reagiert heute sehr gereizt auf Fragen.
examples.translation: He reacts very irritably (irritatedly) to questions today.

examples.sentence: Die Haut ist nach dem Rasieren gereizt.
examples.translation: The skin is irritated after shaving.

examples.sentence: Wenn die Stimmung weniger gereizt wäre, sprächen wir ruhig.
examples.translation: If the mood were less tense (irritable), we would speak calmly.

examples.sentence: Der Stier wird durch das rote Tuch gereizt. (provoked, bull m, cloth n)
examples.translation: The bull is provoked by the red cloth.

entries.intro: Present participle of the strong verb 'verlieren' (to lose - Chunk 1) used as adjective meaning losing. Related to 'Verlust' (#1966) and 'Tiere' (#1967).
entries.usage: Regular adjective (die verlierende Mannschaft - the losing team) or participle adverbial.

examples.sentence: Der Kapitän tröstete das verlierende Team. (Captain m, team n)
examples.translation: The captain consoled the losing team.

examples.sentence: Er ging, den Halt verlierend, zu Boden. (Adverbial: losing grip/footing, grip m)
examples.translation: Losing his footing, he fell to the ground.

examples.sentence: Wenn der verlierende Spieler wütender protestierte, gäbe es Ärger. (Losing player m)
examples.translation: If the losing player protested angrier, there would be trouble.

examples.sentence: Das verlierende Pferd wird vom Jockey angetrieben. (Jockey m, horse n)
examples.translation: The losing horse is driven by the jockey.

entries.intro: A financial loss/deficit, loss of an object/person, or military casualties ('Verluste'). Related to verb 'verlieren'. Related to 'verlierend' (#1965) and 'Tiere' (#1967).
entries.usage: der Verlust, des Verlust(e)s, die Verluste. 'Gewinn und Verlust' (profit and loss). 'Verlustgeschäft' (losing business).

examples.sentence: Die Firma machte dieses Jahr einen großen Verlust.
examples.translation: The company made a major loss this year.

examples.sentence: Der Verlust seines Hundes schmerzt ihn sehr.
examples.translation: The loss of his dog hurts him very much.

examples.sentence: Wenn der Verlust höher wäre, meldete ich Insolvenz an. (Bankruptcy f)
examples.translation: If the loss were higher, I would file for bankruptcy.

examples.sentence: Das Paket wird nach dem Verlust vom Postdienst gesucht. (Mail service m)
examples.translation: The package is searched for by the mail service after the loss.

entries.intro: Plural form of the neuter noun 'Tier' (animal - Chunk 20). Related to 'Flug' (#1968) and 'Beschaffenheit' (#1969).
entries.usage: die Tiere, der Tiere (genitive). Capitalized in German. 'Haustiere' (pets). 'Wildtiere' (wild animals).

examples.sentence: Viele wilde Tiere leben im Nationalpark.
examples.translation: Many wild animals live in the national park.

examples.sentence: Er füttert die Tiere auf dem Bauernhof. (Farm m)
examples.translation: He feeds the animals on the farm.

examples.sentence: Wenn die Tiere zahmer wären, streichelte ich sie.
examples.translation: If the animals were tamer, I would pet them.

examples.sentence: Die Tiere werden vom Tierarzt untersucht. (Vet m)
examples.translation: The animals are examined by the vet.

entries.intro: A flight of a bird/plane, aviation, or air journey. Related to verb 'fliegen'. Related to 'Tiere' (#1967) and 'Beschaffenheit' (#1969).
entries.usage: der Flug, des Flug(e)s, die Flüge (plural with Umlaut). 'Direktflug' (direct flight). 'Rückflug' (return flight). 'Im Flug' (on the wing / quickly).

examples.sentence: Der Flug nach New York dauert acht Stunden.
examples.translation: The flight to New York takes eight hours.

examples.sentence: Wir beobachten den Flug der Wildgänse. (Wild geese pl)
examples.translation: We observe the flight of the wild geese.

examples.sentence: Wenn der Flug billiger wäre, buchte ich ihn sofort.
examples.translation: If the flight were cheaper, I would book it immediately.

examples.sentence: Der Flug wird wegen des Wetters abgesagt.
examples.translation: The flight is canceled due to the weather.

entries.intro: The physical condition, texture, composition, or nature of a material/surface. Suffix -heit makes it feminine. Related to 'Natur' (#1970) and 'Gehaltszulage' (#1971).
entries.usage: die Beschaffenheit, die Beschaffenheiten. 'Bodenbeschaffenheit' (soil condition). 'Oberflächenbeschaffenheit' (surface texture).

examples.sentence: Die Beschaffenheit des Bodens ist lehmig. (Clayey)
examples.translation: The condition of the soil is clayey.

examples.sentence: Wir prüfen die chemische Beschaffenheit des Wassers.
examples.translation: We check the chemical composition of the water.

examples.sentence: Wenn die Beschaffenheit des Stoffs weicher wäre, kaufte ich ihn. (Fabric m)
examples.translation: If the texture of the fabric were softer, I would buy it.

examples.sentence: Die Beschaffenheit der Straße wird von Experten untersucht.
examples.translation: The condition of the road is investigated by experts.

entries.intro: The natural world (scenery/environment), or a person's character/disposition. Loanword. Related to 'Beschaffenheit' (#1969) and 'Gehaltszulage' (#1971).
entries.usage: die Natur, die Naturen (plural rare, nature/temperament). 'Naturschutz' (nature conservation m). 'Von Natur aus' (by nature).

examples.sentence: Er verbringt das Wochenende gern in der Natur.
examples.translation: He likes to spend the weekend in nature.

examples.sentence: Es liegt in der Natur des Menschen zu forschen. (Verbal noun: to research)
examples.translation: It lies in the nature of humans to research.

examples.sentence: Wenn die Natur unberührter wäre, gäbe es mehr Wildtiere.
examples.translation: If nature were more untouched, there would be more wild animals.

examples.sentence: Die Natur wird im Nationalpark streng geschützt.
examples.translation: Nature is strictly protected in the national park.

entries.intro: A salary increase, raise, or bonus allowance. Compound of 'Gehalt' (salary - Chunk 15) and 'Zulage' (allowance/addition). Related to 'Pop' (#1972) and 'Klient' (#1973).
entries.usage: die Gehaltszulage, die Gehaltszulagen.

examples.sentence: Der Chef versprach ihm eine Gehaltszulage. (Boss m)
examples.translation: The boss promised him a salary raise.

examples.sentence: Viele Angestellte fordern eine Gehaltszulage wegen der Inflation.
examples.translation: Many employees demand a salary raise due to inflation.

examples.sentence: Wenn ich eine Gehaltszulage bekäme, kaufte ich das Auto.
examples.translation: If I got a salary raise, I would buy the car.

examples.sentence: Die Gehaltszulage wird im nächsten Monat ausgezahlt.
examples.translation: The salary increase will be paid out next month.

entries.intro: Pop music, or pop culture. Loanword. Related to 'Klient' (#1973) and 'Kunde' (#1974).
entries.usage: der Pop (music). Invariable adjective: pop (pop-style). 'Popkonzert' (pop concert).

examples.sentence: Er hört am liebsten Pop aus den achtziger Jahren. (Eighties pl)
examples.translation: He prefers listening to pop from the eighties.

examples.sentence: Das neue Album ist reiner Pop. (Album n)
examples.translation: The new album is pure pop.

examples.sentence: Wenn das Popkonzert billiger wäre, ginge ich hin.
examples.translation: If the pop concert were cheaper, I would go.

examples.sentence: Die Musikrichtung wird als Pop bezeichnet.
examples.translation: The style of music is designated as pop.

entries.intro: A professional client (represented by a lawyer, consultant, or social worker). Loanword. Related to 'Kunde' (#1974) and 'bombardieren' (#1975).
entries.usage: der Klient, des Klienten, die Klienten. Weak masculine noun (requires -en in inflected forms). Feminine: Klientin.

examples.sentence: Der Anwalt berät seinen Klienten im Büro. (Lawyer m, office n)
examples.translation: The lawyer advises his client in the office.

examples.sentence: Die Agentur betreut viele namhafte Klienten.
examples.translation: The agency manages many well-known clients.

examples.sentence: Wenn der Klient den Vertrag unterschriebe, wäre das Geschäft abgeschlossen.
examples.translation: If the client signed the contract, the business would be concluded.

examples.sentence: Der Klient wird vom Anwalt vor Gericht vertreten.
examples.translation: The client is represented in court by the lawyer.

entries.translation: customer / client (masculine 'der Kunde') / news / information / lore (feminine 'die Kunde')
entries.intro: A commercial customer/client (masculine), or archaic/poetic news/lore (feminine 'die Kunde' - e.g. 'Heimatkunde'). Related to 'Klient' (#1973) and 'bombardieren' (#1975).
entries.usage: der Kunde, des Kunden, die Kunden (customer). die Kunde (news/lore). Weak masculine noun. Feminine: Kundin. 'Stammkunde' (regular customer).

examples.sentence: Der unzufriedene Kunde reklamiert die Ware. (Goods f pl)
examples.translation: The dissatisfied customer complains about the merchandise.

examples.sentence: Sie brachte frohe Kunde aus dem Dorf. (Feminine: news/glad tidings, Dorf n)
examples.translation: She brought glad tidings (glad news) from the village.

examples.sentence: Wenn die Kundin bar bezahlte, gäben wir ihr Rabatt. (Subjunctive verb 'geben')
examples.translation: If the female customer paid in cash, we would give her a discount.

examples.sentence: Der Kunde wird vom Verkäufer freundlich bedient. (Seller m)
examples.translation: The customer is served friendly by the seller.

entries.intro: To militarily bomb/bombard a city, or figuratively pepper/bombard someone with questions/emails. Loanword. Related to 'Bombe' (#1976) and 'fegen' (#1977).
entries.usage: Weak regular verb: bombardieren, bombardierte, hat bombardiert. Transitive. Governs accusative.

examples.sentence: Sie bombardierten die feindliche Festung.
examples.translation: They bombarded the enemy fortress.

examples.sentence: Die Presse bombardiert den Politiker mit Fragen.
examples.translation: The press bombards the politician with questions.

examples.sentence: Wenn die Flieger die Stadt bombardierten, flöhen wir. (Planes pl, flee verb)
examples.translation: If the planes bombed the city, we would flee.

examples.sentence: Die Stellung wird mit Artillerie bombardiert.
examples.translation: The position is bombarded with artillery.

entries.intro: A military explosive bomb, or figuratively a bombshell surprise. Loanword. Related to 'bombardieren' (#1975) and 'fegen' (#1977).
entries.usage: die Bombe, die Bomben. 'Atombombe' (atomic bomb). 'Briefbombe' (letter bomb). 'Die Bombe platzen lassen' (idiom: to drop a bombshell).

examples.sentence: Die Bombe explodierte mitten in der Nacht.
examples.translation: The bomb exploded in the middle of the night.

examples.sentence: Der Spezialist entschärft die alte Bombe.
examples.translation: The specialist defuses the old bomb.

examples.sentence: Wenn die Bombe hochginge, flöge das Haus in die Luft. (Go off / explode, house n)
examples.translation: If the bomb went off, the house would blow up.

examples.sentence: Die Bombe wird vom Kampfmittelräumdienst entschärft. (Disposal service m)
examples.translation: The bomb is defused by the bomb disposal service.

entries.translation: to sweep (floor) / brush / whisk / tear / sweep through (wind)
entries.intro: To sweep a floor with a broom, brush off dust, or sweep/tear through a region (wind/storm). Related to 'Genick' (#1978) and 'Nacken' (#1979).
entries.usage: Weak regular verb: fegen, fegte, hat/ist gefegt. Auxiliary 'haben' for active sweeping, 'sein' for rapid movement (e.g. swept through).

examples.sentence: Er fegt den Schmutz von der Straße.
examples.translation: He sweeps the dirt from the street.

examples.sentence: Der Sturm fegte über das Land. (Auxiliary sein/Präteritum)
examples.translation: The storm swept across the land.

examples.sentence: Wenn du den Hof fegtest, sähe es sauberer aus. (Yard m)
examples.translation: If you swept the yard, it would look cleaner.

examples.sentence: Die Küche wird jeden Samstag gefegt.
examples.translation: The kitchen is swept every Saturday.

entries.translation: nape of the neck / neck (anatomical - back part)
entries.intro: The back of the neck or nape (anatomical). Related to 'Nacken' (#1979) and 'fehlerverdächtig' (#1980).
entries.usage: das Genick, des Genick(e)s, die Genicke. 'Das Genick brechen' (idiom: to break one's neck / spell ruin).

examples.sentence: Er packte das Kaninchen im Genick. (Rabbit n)
examples.translation: He grabbed the rabbit by the neck.

examples.sentence: Der Sturz brach ihm das Genick. (Break neck / ruin)
examples.translation: The fall broke his neck.

examples.sentence: Wenn das Genick gebrochen wäre, stürbe das Tier sofort. (Subjunctive verb 'sterben')
examples.translation: If the neck were broken, the animal would die immediately.

examples.sentence: Das Genick wird vom Orthopäden untersucht.
examples.translation: The neck is examined by the orthopedist.

entries.translation: nape of the neck / back of the neck
entries.intro: The nape or back of the neck. Related to 'Genick' (#1978) and 'fehlerverdächtig' (#1980).
entries.usage: der Nacken, des Nackens, die Nacken (plural identical). 'Nackenschmerzen' (neck pain pl). 'Jemandem im Nacken sitzen' (idiom: to breathe down someone's neck).

examples.sentence: Er reibt sich den verspannten Nacken. (Tense neck)
examples.translation: He rubs his tense neck.

examples.sentence: Die Haare hängen ihr in den Nacken.
examples.translation: Her hair hangs down her neck.

examples.sentence: Wenn mein Nacken wärmer wäre, spürte ich keinen Schmerz. (Subjunctive verb 'spüren')
examples.translation: If my neck were warmer, I wouldn't feel pain.

examples.sentence: Der Nacken wird von der Masseurin massiert. (Masseuse f)
examples.translation: The neck is massaged by the masseuse.

entries.translation: error-prone / suspicious of error / buggy / dubiously
entries.intro: Describes software or processes prone to errors or suspicious of having faults. Compound of 'Fehler' (error - Chunk 1) and 'verdächtig' (suspicious - Chunk 12). Related to 'suspekt' (#1981) and 'warm' (#1982).
entries.usage: Regular adjective (ein fehlerverdächtiger Code). Adverbial: dubiously.

examples.sentence: Das neue Software-Update wirkt sehr fehlerverdächtig.
examples.translation: The new software update looks very error-prone.

examples.sentence: Er prüft die fehlerverdächtigen Zeilen im Code.
examples.translation: He checks the suspicious lines in the code.

examples.sentence: Wenn das Programm fehlerverdächtiger wäre, startete ich es nicht.
examples.translation: If the program were more error-prone, I wouldn't start it.

examples.sentence: Die Berechnung wird als fehlerverdächtig eingestuft.
examples.translation: The calculation is classified as error-prone.

entries.intro: Describes a suspicious person, fishy situation, or shady deal. Loanword. Related to 'fehlerverdächtig' (#1980) and 'warm' (#1982).
entries.usage: Regular adjective (ein suspekter Mann). Adverbial: suspiciously. 'Jemandem suspekt sein' (to seem suspicious to someone).

examples.sentence: Dieser Kerl ist mir suspekt. (Kerl m)
examples.translation: This guy seems suspicious to me.

examples.sentence: Das Angebot klingt sehr suspekt. (Offer n)
examples.translation: The offer sounds very fishy (suspicious).

examples.sentence: Wenn das Geschäft nicht suspekt wäre, unterschriebe ich den Vertrag.
examples.translation: If the deal weren't suspicious, I would sign the contract.

examples.sentence: Der Verdächtige wird als suspekt beschrieben.
examples.translation: The suspect is described as suspicious.

entries.intro: Describes warm temperature, hot food, cozy rooms, or behaving warmly. Related to 'extra' (#1983) and 'Flasche' (#1984).
entries.usage: Regular adjective (ein warmer Tag). Adverbial: warmly. 'Sich warm anziehen' (idiom: to brace oneself / dress warmly).

examples.sentence: Die Suppe ist noch angenehm warm.
examples.translation: The soup is still pleasantly warm.

examples.sentence: Er begrüßte uns sehr warm. (Warmly/cordially)
examples.translation: He greeted us very warmly.

examples.sentence: Wenn das Wetter wärmer wäre, schwömmen wir im See. (Lake m)
examples.translation: If the weather were warmer, we would swim in the lake.

examples.sentence: Das Essen wird im Ofen warm gehalten.
examples.translation: The food is kept warm in the oven.

entries.translation: extra / additional / specially / on purpose / separate (adjective)
entries.intro: Describes extra items, additional costs, or acts as adverb meaning specially/on purpose. Loanword. Related to 'warm' (#1982) and 'Flasche' (#1984).
entries.usage: Invariable adjective (ein extra Zimmer). Adverbial: specially / on purpose (e.g. 'extra kommen').

examples.sentence: Für diesen Service fallen extra Gebühren an. (Fees pl)
examples.translation: Extra fees apply for this service.

examples.sentence: Ich bin extra wegen dir gekommen. (Specially)
examples.translation: I came specially because of you.

examples.sentence: Wenn wir ein extra Bett brauchten, bezahlten wir mehr.
examples.translation: If we needed an extra bed, we would pay more.

examples.sentence: Das Paket wird extra verpackt. (Specially/separately)
examples.translation: The package is wrapped specially.

entries.intro: A glass/plastic bottle, flask, or colloquially a failure/loser person. Related to 'Lastwagen' (#1985) and 'Möbelwagen' (#1986).
entries.usage: die Flasche, die Flaschen. 'Wasserflasche' (water bottle). 'Nuckelflasche' (baby bottle). 'Eine Flasche sein' (to be a loser/failure).

examples.sentence: Er öffnet eine Flasche Rotwein. (Red wine m)
examples.translation: He opens a bottle of red wine.

examples.sentence: Der Trainer schimpfte: Ihr seid alle Flaschen! (Losers/failures pl)
examples.translation: The coach scolded: You are all failures (losers)!

examples.sentence: Wenn die Flasche voller wäre, tränke ich noch ein Glas.
examples.translation: If the bottle were fuller, I would drink another glass.

examples.sentence: Die Milch wird in Flaschen abgefüllt.
examples.translation: The milk is bottled (filled into bottles).

entries.intro: A truck or lorry. Compound of 'Last' (load/burden) and 'Wagen' (wagon/car - Chunk 4). Related to 'Möbelwagen' (#1986) and 'Hunde' (#1987).
entries.usage: der Lastwagen, des Lastwagens, die Lastwagen (plural identical). Abbreviation: Lkw.

examples.sentence: Der Lastwagen transportiert Sand zur Baustelle. (Construction site f)
examples.translation: The truck is transporting sand to the construction site.

examples.sentence: Ein großer Lastwagen parkt vor dem Haus.
examples.translation: A large truck is parked in front of the house.

examples.sentence: Wenn der Lastwagen leerer wäre, verbrauchte er weniger Diesel. (Diesel m)
examples.translation: If the truck were emptier, it would consume less diesel.

examples.sentence: Die Ware wird vom Lastwagen abgeladen. (Goods f pl)
examples.translation: The merchandise is unloaded from the truck.

entries.intro: A furniture moving van or truck. Compound of 'Möbel' (furniture - Chunk 13) and 'Wagen' (wagon/car - Chunk 4). Related to 'Lastwagen' (#1985) and 'Hunde' (#1987).
entries.usage: der Möbelwagen, des Möbelwagens, die Möbelwagen (plural identical). 'Umzugswagen' (moving van).

examples.sentence: Der Möbelwagen steht vor dem neuen Haus.
examples.translation: The moving van (furniture truck) stands in front of the new house.

examples.sentence: Sie beladen den Möbelwagen mit Kisten. (Crates pl)
examples.translation: They are loading the moving van with crates.

examples.sentence: Wenn der Möbelwagen größer wäre, passte das Sofa hinein. (Sofa n)
examples.translation: If the moving van were larger, the sofa would fit inside.

examples.sentence: Der Möbelwagen wird von der Umzugsfirma gemietet. (Moving firm f)
examples.translation: The moving van is rented by the moving company.

entries.intro: Plural form of the masculine noun 'Hund' (dog - Chunk 1), or historically miners' trolleys/carts. Related to 'ausgelassen' (#1988), 'stürmisch' (#1989), and 'wild' (#1990).
entries.usage: die Hunde, der Hunde (genitive). Capitalized in German. 'Wachhunde' (guard dogs).

examples.sentence: Die Hunde bellen laut im Hof. (Yard m)
examples.translation: The dogs bark loudly in the yard.

examples.sentence: Er geht mit seinen Hunden im Wald spazieren.
examples.translation: He goes for a walk with his dogs in the forest.

examples.sentence: Wenn die Hunde zahmer wären, hätte ich keine Angst.
examples.translation: If the dogs were tamer, I wouldn't be afraid.

examples.sentence: Die Hunde werden vom Besitzer dressiert. (Owner m)
examples.translation: The dogs are trained by the owner.

entries.translation: boisterous / frolicsome / merry / skipped / omitted / auslassen
entries.intro: Past participle of the strong separable verb 'auslassen' (to skip/omit / let out - Chunk 20 companion) used as adjective meaning boisterous, frolicsome, or skipped. Related to 'stürmisch' (#1989) and 'wild' (#1990).
entries.usage: Regular adjective (eine ausgelassene Stimmung - a boisterous mood) or past participle.

examples.sentence: Die Jugendlichen feierten eine ausgelassene Party.
examples.translation: The youths celebrated a boisterous (wild) party.

examples.sentence: Er hat diese Zeile im Buch einfach ausgelassen. (Omitted/skipped, line f)
examples.translation: He simply skipped this line in the book.

examples.sentence: Wenn die Feier ausgelassener wäre, bliebe ich länger.
examples.translation: If the celebration were more boisterous, I would stay longer.

examples.sentence: Der Schritt wird beim Kochen ausgelassen. (Skipped/omitted, step m)
examples.translation: The step is skipped during cooking.

entries.intro: Describes stormy weather, turbulent periods, passionate greetings, or boisterous behavior. Derived from 'Sturm' (storm). Related to 'ausgelassen' (#1988) and 'wild' (#1990).
entries.usage: Regular adjective (ein stürmischer Herbsttag). Adverbial: stormily.

examples.sentence: Das Wetter auf See war stürmisch.
examples.translation: The weather at sea was stormy.

examples.sentence: Sie begrüßten sich mit stürmischer Freude.
examples.translation: They greeted each other with passionate (stormy) joy.

examples.sentence: Wenn die Nacht stürmischer wäre, blieben wir im Haus.
examples.translation: If the night were stormier, we would stay in the house.

examples.sentence: Der Applaus wird stürmisch vorgetragen. (Delivered stormily/passive)
examples.translation: The applause is delivered passionately.

entries.intro: Describes wild animals/nature, fierce behavior, or declines as noun meaning game/venison ('das Wild'). Related to 'lächerlich' (#1991) and 'Lee' (#1992).
entries.usage: Regular adjective (ein wildes Tier). Noun: das Wild (game/venison). Adverbial: wildly.

examples.sentence: Die wilden Rosen blühen im Wald. (Roses pl)
examples.translation: The wild roses bloom in the forest.

examples.sentence: Der Jäger schießt das Wild im Revier. (Game n, hunting ground n)
examples.translation: The hunter shoots the game in the hunting ground.

examples.sentence: Wenn das Pferd wilder wäre, ritte er es nicht.
examples.translation: If the horse were wilder, he wouldn't ride it.

examples.sentence: Das Kind wird durch den Lärm wild gemacht.
examples.translation: The child is made wild (agitated) by the noise.

entries.intro: Describes ridiculous claims, laughable amounts, or absurd behavior. Derived from verb 'lachen' (to laugh). Related to 'wild' (#1990) and 'Lee' (#1992).
entries.usage: Regular adjective (ein lächerlicher Preis). Adverbial: ridiculously. 'Sich lächerlich machen' (to make a fool of oneself).

examples.sentence: Er macht sich mit seinem Kostüm lächerlich. (Costume n)
examples.translation: He makes himself ridiculous with his costume.

examples.sentence: Das Angebot ist geradezu lächerlich.
examples.translation: The offer is down right ridiculous.

examples.sentence: Wenn die Ausrede lächerlicher wäre, glaubte ihm niemand.
examples.translation: If the excuse were more ridiculous, no one would believe him.

examples.sentence: Der Vorwurf wird als lächerlich abgewiesen. (Accusation m)
examples.translation: The accusation is dismissed as ridiculous.

entries.intro: The leeward side (away from the wind) in sailing. Opposite of 'Luv' (windward). Related to 'Tier' (#1993) and 'gezeigt' (#1994).
entries.usage: das Lee. Plural is not used. 'In Lee' (leeward).

examples.sentence: Das Schiff dreht nach Lee.
examples.translation: The ship turns to leeward (lee).

examples.sentence: Wir stehen im Lee der Hütte sicher vor dem Wind. (Cabin f)
examples.translation: We stand in the lee of the cabin, safe from the wind.

examples.sentence: Wenn wir tiefer in Lee segelten, spürten wir den Wind weniger.
examples.translation: If we sailed deeper into the lee, we would feel the wind less.

examples.sentence: Die Position wird auf der Leeseite bestimmt. (Leeward side f)
examples.translation: The position is determined on the leeward side.

entries.intro: A general animal, beast, or creature. Related to 'gezeigt' (#1994) and 'zeigte' (#1995).
entries.usage: das Tier, des Tier(e)s, die Tiere. 'Säugetier' (mammal). 'Nutztier' (livestock n). 'Hohes Tier' (idiom: big shot / VIP).

examples.sentence: Das treue Tier wich nicht von seiner Seite.
examples.translation: The loyal animal did not leave his side.

examples.sentence: Ein wildes Tier schleicht durch den Garten.
examples.translation: A wild animal is sneaking through the garden.

examples.sentence: Wenn das Tier hungriger wäre, fräße es das Fleisch. (Subjunctive verb 'fressen', meat n)
examples.translation: If the animal were hungrier, it would eat the meat.

examples.sentence: Das kranke Tier wird vom Pfleger gefüttert. (Keeper m)
examples.translation: The sick animal is fed by the keeper.

entries.intro: Past participle of the verb 'zeigen' (to show - Chunk 1) used as adjective meaning shown or demonstrated. Related to 'zeigte' (#1995) and 'emporschießend' (#1996).
entries.usage: Regular adjective or past participle. 'Wie gezeigt' (as shown).

examples.sentence: Das Bild wurde in der Galerie gezeigt.
examples.translation: The painting was shown in the gallery.

examples.sentence: Er hat uns seinen neuen Garten gezeigt.
examples.translation: He showed us his new garden.

examples.sentence: Wenn die Lösung deutlicher gezeigt würde, verstünde ich sie.
examples.translation: If the solution were shown clearer, I would understand it.

examples.sentence: Der Film wird morgen im Kino gezeigt.
examples.translation: The movie will be shown in the cinema tomorrow.

entries.intro: Simple past tense (Präteritum) first/third person singular of the verb 'zeigen' (to show/point out - Chunk 1). Related to 'gezeigt' (#1994) and 'emporschießend' (#1996).
entries.usage: Weak regular verb Präteritum: ich zeigte, er/sie/es zeigte. Transitive or reflexive.

examples.sentence: Er zeigte mir den richtigen Weg.
examples.translation: He showed me the correct way.

examples.sentence: Sie zeigte großes Interesse an dem Buch. (Interest n)
examples.translation: She displayed great interest in the book.

examples.sentence: Wenn ich dir die Fotos zeigte, stauntest du. (Subjunctive verb 'zeigen')
examples.translation: If I showed you the photos, you would be amazed.

examples.sentence: Das Gemälde wurde ausgestellt, während er es zeigte. (Active/passive helper)
examples.translation: The painting was exhibited while he showed it.

entries.intro: Present participle of the strong separable verb 'emporschießen' (to shoot up / soar - Chunk 8 companion) used as adjective meaning shooting up or soaring. Related to 'scharfschießen' (#1997) and 'schießend' (#1998).
entries.usage: Regular adjective or participle adverbial.

examples.sentence: Wir beobachten die emporschießenden Flammen des Feuers. (Flames pl)
examples.translation: We observe the shooting-up flames of the fire.

examples.sentence: Die Stadt hat eine emporschießende Wirtschaft.
examples.translation: The city has a soaring (rapidly growing) economy.

examples.sentence: Wenn das Gebäude noch emporschießender wirkte, überragte es die Stadt.
examples.translation: If the building looked even more soaring, it would tower over the city.

examples.sentence: Die emporschießende Pflanze wird vom Gärtner gegossen. (Plant f)
examples.translation: The shooting-up plant is watered by the gardener.

entries.translation: to shoot with live ammunition / live firing (noun: 'Scharfschießen')
entries.intro: To shoot with live ammunition, or the military/police live-fire exercise. Compound of adjective 'scharf' (sharp/live - Chunk 13 companion) and verb 'schießen' (to shoot - Chunk 11 companion). Related to 'schießend' (#1998) and 'behält' (#1999).
entries.usage: Strong irregular verb: scharfschießen, schoss scharf, hat scharfgeschossen. Noun: das Scharfschießen, des Scharfschießens.

examples.sentence: Die Soldaten müssen heute scharfschießen.
examples.translation: The soldiers have to shoot with live ammunition today.

examples.sentence: Das Scharfschießen findet auf dem Truppenübungsplatz statt. (Noun: live firing, training ground m)
examples.translation: The live firing takes place on the military training ground.

examples.sentence: Wenn wir scharfschössen, trügen wir Gehörschutz. (Subjunctive verb 'scharfschießen', ear protection m)
examples.translation: If we shot with live ammunition, we would wear ear protection.

examples.sentence: Die Übung wird als Scharfschießen angekündigt. (Live firing n)
examples.translation: The exercise is announced as live firing.

entries.intro: Present participle of the strong verb 'schießen' (to shoot - Chunk 11 companion) used as adjective meaning shooting. Related to 'behält' (#1999) and 'hält' (#2000).
entries.usage: Regular adjective or participle adverbial.

examples.sentence: Wir sahen die auf Scheiben schießenden Polizisten. (Targets pl)
examples.translation: We saw the police officers shooting at targets.

examples.sentence: Er verbrachte die Zeit, Tore schießend. (Adverbial: shooting goals)
examples.translation: He spent the time shooting goals.

examples.sentence: Wenn der schießende Jäger besser zielte, träfe er das Wild. (Hunter m, game n)
examples.translation: If the shooting hunter aimed better, he would hit the game.

examples.sentence: Das schießende Kriegsschiff wird vom Gegner attackiert. (Warship n)
examples.translation: The firing warship is attacked by the opponent.

entries.intro: Present 3rd person singular of the strong verb 'behalten' (to keep / retain / remember - Chunk 3). Related to 'hält' (#2000) and 'Geschütze' (#2001).
entries.usage: Strong verb: behalten, behielt, hat behalten. present: er behält. Transitive. Governs accusative.

examples.sentence: Er behält das Wechselgeld für sich. (Change n)
examples.translation: He keeps the change for himself.

examples.sentence: Sie behält den Vorfall im Gedächtnis.
examples.translation: She keeps (retains) the incident in her memory.

examples.sentence: Wenn ich recht behielte, gewönne ich die Wette. (Subjunctive verb 'behalten', bet f)
examples.translation: If I were right, I would win the bet.

examples.sentence: Der Kassenbon wird behalten, weil er als Beweis dient. (Receipt m)
examples.translation: The receipt is kept because it serves as proof.

entries.translation: holds / keeps / stops / thinks (of: 'halten von') / halten
entries.intro: Present 3rd person singular of the strong verb 'halten' (to hold / keep / stop / think of - Chunk 18 companion). Related to 'Geschütze' (#2001) and 'Gewehre' (#2002).
entries.usage: Strong verb: halten, hielt, hat gehalten. present: er hält. Transitive, intransitive, or reflexive.

examples.sentence: Er hält ein Buch in der Hand.
examples.translation: He holds a book in his hand.

examples.sentence: Der Zug hält an jeder Station.
examples.translation: The train stops at every station.

examples.sentence: Wenn der Fahrer die Spur hielte, gäbe es keinen Unfall. (Lane f)
examples.translation: If the driver kept in the lane, there would be no accident.

examples.sentence: Das Versprechen wird gehalten, solange er hält. (Active/passive helper)
examples.translation: The promise is kept as long as he keeps it.

entries.intro: Plural form of the neuter noun 'Geschütz' (cannon/heavy gun/artillery). Related to 'Gewehre' (#2002) and 'Kanonen' (#2003).
entries.usage: die Geschütze, der Geschütze (genitive). Capitalized in German. 'Schwere Geschütze auffahren' (idiom: to bring out the big guns).

examples.sentence: Die Soldaten brachten die Geschütze in Position.
examples.translation: The soldiers brought the guns (cannons) into position.

examples.sentence: Die Festung hat viele schwere Geschütze.
examples.translation: The fortress has many heavy guns.

examples.sentence: Wenn die Geschütze geladen wären, schössen sie.
examples.translation: If the guns were loaded, they would shoot.

examples.sentence: Die Geschütze werden vom Feind zerstört.
examples.translation: The cannons are destroyed by the enemy.

entries.intro: Plural form of the neuter noun 'Gewehr' (rifle/gun - Chunk 11 companion). Related to 'Geschütze' (#2001) and 'Kanonen' (#2003).
entries.usage: die Gewehre, der Gewehre. Capitalized in German. 'Gewehrlauf' (gun barrel m).

examples.sentence: Die Wachen tragen geladene Gewehre.
examples.translation: The guards carry loaded rifles.

examples.sentence: Sie reinigen die Gewehre nach der Übung.
examples.translation: They clean the guns (rifles) after the exercise.

examples.sentence: Wenn keine Gewehre existierten, gäbe es weniger Gewalt. (Violence f)
examples.translation: If no rifles existed, there would be less violence.

examples.sentence: Die Gewehre werden in der Waffenkammer aufbewahrt. (Armory f)
examples.translation: The rifles are kept in the armory.

entries.intro: Plural form of the feminine noun 'Kanone' (cannon/gun). Related to 'Geschütze' (#2001) and 'Gewehre' (#2002).
entries.usage: die Kanonen, der Kanonen. Capitalized in German. 'Kanonenkugel' (cannonball f). 'Mit Kanonen auf Spatzen schießen' (idiom: to use a sledgehammer to crack a nut).

examples.sentence: Die alten Kanonen stehen auf der Burgmauer. (Castle wall f)
examples.translation: The old cannons stand on the castle wall.

examples.sentence: Das Schiff hat zwanzig eiserne Kanonen.
examples.translation: The ship has twenty iron cannons.

examples.sentence: Wenn die Kanonen lauter schössen, erschräken wir.
examples.translation: If the cannons shot louder, we would be startled.

examples.sentence: Die Kanonen werden mit Schwarzpulver geladen. (Gunpowder n)
examples.translation: The cannons are loaded with gunpowder.

entries.intro: Describes medical topics, treatment, or medicinal products. Related to 'medizinische' (#2005) and 'Scham' (#2006).
entries.usage: Regular adjective (eine medizinische Behandlung). Adverbial: medically.

examples.sentence: Er benötigt dringend medizinische Hilfe.
examples.translation: He needs urgent medical help.

examples.sentence: Das Produkt wird als medizinisch deklariert.
examples.translation: The product is declared as medicinal (medical).

examples.sentence: Wenn die Ausrüstung medizinischer wäre, hülfe sie besser.
examples.translation: If the equipment were more medical-grade, it would help better.

examples.sentence: Der Fall wird aus medizinischen Gründen untersucht.
examples.translation: The case is investigated for medical reasons.

entries.intro: Inflected feminine/plural/weak form of the adjective 'medizinisch' (#2004). Related to 'Scham' (#2006) and 'Schande' (#2007).
entries.usage: Inflected adjective (eine medizinische Untersuchung).

examples.sentence: Die medizinische Fakultät ist sehr renommiert.
examples.translation: The medical faculty is very renowned.

examples.sentence: Sie macht eine medizinische Ausbildung.
examples.translation: She is doing a medical training course.

examples.sentence: Wenn das eine medizinische Maske wäre, schützte sie besser.
examples.translation: If that were a medical mask, it would protect better.

examples.sentence: Die medizinische Versorgung wird vom Staat finanziert.
examples.translation: Medical care is financed by the state.

entries.intro: The feeling of shame or embarrassment, moral modesty, or anatomical pubic region. Related to 'Schande' (#2007) and 'Schamgefühl' (#2008).
entries.usage: die Scham. Plural is not used. 'Schamlippen' (labia pl). 'Vor Scham erröten' (to blush with shame).

examples.sentence: Sie errötete vor Scham.
examples.translation: She blushed with shame.

examples.sentence: Er empfindet keine Scham für seine Tat.
examples.translation: He feels no shame for his deed.

examples.sentence: Wenn ich Scham fühlte, entschuldigte ich mich.
examples.translation: If I felt shame, I would apologize.

examples.sentence: Das Schamgefühl wird durch Erziehung geformt. (Shame/modesty n)
examples.translation: The sense of shame is shaped by education.

entries.intro: A public disgrace, shame, dishonor, or scandal. Related to verb 'schänden'. Related to 'Scham' (#2006) and 'Schamgefühl' (#2008).
entries.usage: die Schande. Plural is rare. 'Zu Schande machen' (to ruin / shame). 'Das ist eine Schande!' (that's a shame/disgrace!).

examples.sentence: Sein kriminelles Verhalten ist eine Schande für die Familie.
examples.translation: His criminal behavior is a disgrace (shame) to the family.

examples.sentence: Es wäre eine Schande, das Essen wegzuwerfen.
examples.translation: It would be a shame to throw the food away.

examples.sentence: Wenn das eine Schande für uns wäre, schwiege ich. (Subjunctive verb 'schweigen')
examples.translation: If that were a disgrace for us, I would keep silent.

examples.sentence: Der Name wird durch die Schande befleckt. (Stained)
examples.translation: The name is stained by the disgrace.

entries.intro: The cognitive sense of shame, modesty, or embarrassment. Compound of 'Scham' (shame - #2006) and 'Gefühl' (feeling - Chunk 7). Related to 'Scham' (#2006) and 'Schande' (#2007).
entries.usage: das Schamgefühl, des Schamgefühl(e)s, die Schamgefühle.

examples.sentence: Das Kind hat noch kein ausgeprägtes Schamgefühl. (Developed)
examples.translation: The child does not have a highly developed sense of shame yet.

examples.sentence: Ihr Schamgefühl hinderte sie daran, darüber zu sprechen.
examples.translation: Her sense of shame prevented her from speaking about it.

examples.sentence: Wenn sein Schamgefühl größer wäre, errötete er jetzt.
examples.translation: If his sense of shame were greater, he would blush now.

examples.sentence: Das Schamgefühl wird von kulturellen Werten beeinflusst. (Values pl)
examples.translation: The sense of shame is influenced by cultural values.

entries.intro: Present participle of the verb 'hoffen' (to hope - Chunk 1) used as adjective meaning hoping. Related to 'wen' (#2010) and 'Vogel' (#2011).
entries.usage: Regular adjective or participle adverbial.

examples.sentence: Die auf Rettung hoffenden Bergleute warteten. (Miners pl)
examples.translation: The miners hoping for rescue waited.

examples.sentence: Er verbrachte die Nacht, auf ein Zeichen hoffend. (Sign n)
examples.translation: He spent the night hoping for a sign.

examples.sentence: Wenn das hoffende Kind leiser weinte, schlief ich. (Subjunctive verb 'weinen')
examples.translation: If the hoping child cried quieter, I would sleep.

examples.sentence: Die Briefe werden von den hoffenden Eltern gelesen.
examples.translation: The letters are read by the hoping parents.

entries.intro: Interrogative pronoun in the accusative case (whom). Related to 'Vogel' (#2011) and 'Majestät' (#2012).
entries.usage: Accusative interrogative pronoun. Governs accusative object questions.

examples.sentence: Wen hast du gestern im Park gesehen?
examples.translation: Whom did you see in the park yesterday?

examples.sentence: Wen meinst du eigentlich mit dieser Bemerkung? (Remark f)
examples.translation: Whom do you actually mean by this remark?

examples.sentence: Wen es auch beträfe, wir müssten handeln. (Subjunctive verb 'betreffen')
examples.translation: Whomsoever it concerned, we would have to act.

examples.sentence: Wen wird das Komitee als Gewinner nominieren? (Active trigger)
examples.translation: Whom will the committee nominate as the winner?

entries.intro: A biological bird, or colloquially a guy/fellow. Related to 'Majestät' (#2012) and 'wen' (#2010).
entries.usage: der Vogel, des Vogels, die Vögel (plural with Umlaut). 'Zugvogel' (migratory bird). 'Einen Vogel haben' (idiom: to be crazy).

examples.sentence: Der bunte Vogel singt auf dem Ast. (Branch m)
examples.translation: The colorful bird is singing on the branch.

examples.sentence: Er ist ein komischer Vogel. (Colloquial: strange guy)
examples.translation: He is a strange fellow.

examples.sentence: Wenn der Vogel flöge, sähe ich seine Flügel. (Wings pl)
examples.translation: If the bird flew, I would see its wings.

examples.sentence: Der Vogel wird im Käfig gehalten. (Cage m)
examples.translation: The bird is kept in the cage.

entries.intro: A royal title (Majesty), or majestic dignity/grandeur. Loanword. Related to 'Vogel' (#2011).
entries.usage: die Majestät, die Majestäten. 'Eure Majestät' (Your Majesty). 'Majestätsbeleidigung' (lese-majesty f).

examples.sentence: Seine Majestät der König betritt den Thronsaal. (Throne room m)
examples.translation: His Majesty the king enters the throne room.

examples.sentence: Die Alpen haben eine wilde Majestät. (Grandeur)
examples.translation: The Alps have a wild grandeur (majesty).

examples.sentence: Wenn Eure Majestät es befehlte, griffe ich an. (Subjunctive verb 'befehlen')
examples.translation: If Your Majesty ordered it, I would attack.

examples.sentence: Die Königin wird von Ihrer Majestät repräsentiert.
examples.translation: The queen is represented by Her Majesty.

entries.intro: To steal or pilfer items (formal/legal term).
entries.usage: Weak regular verb: entwenden, entwendete, hat entwendet. Transitive. Governs accusative.

examples.sentence: Er wollte ein Buch aus der Bibliothek entwenden.
examples.translation: He wanted to steal a book from the library.

examples.sentence: Jemand entwendete seine Brieftasche im Zug. (Wallet f)
examples.translation: Someone stole his wallet on the train.

examples.sentence: Wenn er das Auto entwendete, fände es die Polizei schnell.
examples.translation: If he stole the car, the police would find it quickly.

examples.sentence: Die Geldbörse wird heimlich entwendet. (Purse f)
examples.translation: The purse is secretly stolen.

entries.translation: to act / operate / perform / take action
entries.intro: To act in a certain role, operate as an organization, or take action in a situation. Loanword.
entries.usage: Weak regular verb: agieren, agierte, hat agiert. Intransitive. Governs 'als' + nominative or adverbial.

examples.sentence: Wir müssen in dieser Krise schnell agieren. (Crisis f)
examples.translation: We must act quickly in this crisis.

examples.sentence: Die Firma agiert weltweit auf dem Markt.
examples.translation: The company operates globally in the market.

examples.sentence: Wenn wir klüger agierten, sparten wir Steuern.
examples.translation: If we acted wiser, we would save taxes.

examples.sentence: Die Rolle wird von einem Schauspieler agiert. (Uncommon/archaic passive - usually active/theater)
examples.translation: The role is performed by an actor.

entries.translation: to hold office / officiate / act (in capacity)
entries.intro: To hold an official office, act as a chairman/officiant, or serve in capacity.
entries.usage: Weak regular verb: amtieren, amtierte, hat amtiert. Intransitive. Governs 'als' + nominative.

examples.sentence: Er wird ab nächstem Monat als Vorsitzender amtieren. (Chairman m)
examples.translation: He will hold office as chairman starting next month.

examples.sentence: Der Richter amtierte viele Jahre an diesem Gericht.
examples.translation: The judge officiated for many years at this court.

examples.sentence: Wenn er länger amtierte, änderte sich die Politik.
examples.translation: If he held office longer, the politics would change.

examples.sentence: Es wird im Standesamt amtiert. (Impersonal passive context)
examples.translation: Officiating is carried out in the registry office.

entries.translation: to schedule / dispose / plan / organize / re-route
entries.intro: To schedule deliveries/trucks, dispose of resources, plan, or re-route logistics. Loanword.
entries.usage: Weak regular verb: disponieren, disponierte, hat disponiert. Transitive or intransitive. Governs accusative or 'über' + accusative.

examples.sentence: Wir müssen die Waren für das Lager neu disponieren. (Goods f pl)
examples.translation: We must re-schedule (plan) the merchandise for the warehouse.

examples.sentence: Er disponiert über ein großes Budget. (Governs 'über': disposes of)
examples.translation: He disposes of a large budget.

examples.sentence: Wenn du die Lkw früher disponiertest, sparten wir Zeit. (Trucks pl)
examples.translation: If you scheduled the trucks earlier, we would save time.

examples.sentence: Die Transporte werden täglich neu disponiert.
examples.translation: The transports are rescheduled daily.

entries.translation: to groan / moan / sigh / complain loudly
entries.intro: To physically groan with pain, moan, or complain loudly about something.
entries.usage: Weak regular verb: stöhnen, stöhnte, hat gestöhnt. Intransitive. Governs 'über' + accusative.

examples.sentence: Der Kranke stöhnt leise im Bett.
examples.translation: The sick person groans softly in bed.

examples.sentence: Alle stöhnen über das schlechte Wetter.
examples.translation: Everyone groans (complains) about the bad weather.

examples.sentence: Wenn wir nicht so viel stöhnten, wäre die Stimmung besser.
examples.translation: If we didn't groan (complain) so much, the mood would be better.

examples.sentence: Es wird über die hohen Preise gestöhnt.
examples.translation: There is groaning about the high prices.

entries.translation: to irritate / provoke / tempt / attract / appeal to
entries.intro: To physically irritate skin/eyes, provoke someone, or tempt/appeal to someone.
entries.usage: Weak regular verb: reizen, reizte, hat gereizt. Transitive. Governs accusative.

examples.sentence: Der Rauch reizt meine Atemwege. (Smoke m, airways pl)
examples.translation: The smoke irritates my airways.

examples.sentence: Die Idee reizt mich sehr. (Appeals/tempts)
examples.translation: The idea appeals to me very much.

examples.sentence: Wenn du ihn reiztest, würde er wütend.
examples.translation: If you provoked him, he would become angry.

examples.sentence: Der Hund wird von den Kindern gereizt.
examples.translation: The dog is provoked by the children.

entries.translation: to skip / omit / let out (rage/steam) / render (fat)
entries.intro: To skip/omit text/steps, let out anger/rage on someone ('an' + dative), or render fat in cooking.
entries.usage: Strong irregular separable verb: auslassen, ließ aus, hat ausgelassen. present: er lässt aus. Transitive or reflexive.

examples.sentence: Bitte lass diese schwierige Übung aus. (Exercise f)
examples.translation: Please skip this difficult exercise.

examples.sentence: Er lässt seinen Frust an mir aus. (Frustration m)
examples.translation: He lets his frustration out on me.

examples.sentence: Wenn du den Schritt ausließest, funktionierte das Gerät nicht. (Step m)
examples.translation: If you skipped the step, the device wouldn't work.

examples.sentence: Die Butter wird in der heißen Pfanne ausgelassen. (Rendered, butter f, pan f)
examples.translation: The butter is rendered in the hot pan.
